episodic.content: On 2026-10-20, Project ORBIT-NIGHTLY recorded that Mira remains the owner, STREAM-93 is approved for staging only after AUDIT-62 passes, POLL-71 must remain in staging until then, and no production rollout is authorized.

procedural.content: For Project ORBIT-NIGHTLY, keep POLL-71 in staging until AUDIT-62 passes; only after it passes may staging use STREAM-93. Do not roll out to production.
